self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Sharpshooter (R1): after a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further 8% every 0.1s the arrow is in the air, up to 5 times. Modeled at max stacks (+40%). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: An extremely ancient bow that has retained its power despite its original master being long gone. It draws power from everyone and everything in the world, and the further away you are from that which your heart desires, the more powerful it is.

refinements.1: Increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by <r>12%</r>. After a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further <r>8%</r> every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.
refinements.2: Increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by <r>15%</r>. After a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further <r>10%</r> every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.
refinements.3: Increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by <r>18%</r>. After a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further <r>12%</r> every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.
refinements.4: Increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by <r>21%</r>. After a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further <r>14%</r> every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.
refinements.5: Increases Normal and Charged Attack DMG by <r>24%</r>. After a Normal or Charged Attack is fired, DMG dealt increases by a further <r>16%</r> every 0.1s the arrow is in the air for up to 5 times.

fr.flavor: Un arc extrêmement ancien. Même si son maître d'origine n'est plus, on sent encore son pouvoir, drainé de tous les êtres de ce monde. Plus l'objet de vos désirs se trouve loin, et meilleure est sa puissance.

refinements.1: Augmente les DGT infligés par les attaques normales et les attaques chargées de <r>12 %</r>. Les DGT augmentent de <r>8 %</r> toutes les 0,1 s après avoir tiré une flèche d'attaque normale ou chargée. Cet effet peut être cumulé 5 fois maximum.
